entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Make PInvoke Stubs in NativeAOT optinal #128289
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: System.Text.Json.SourceGeneration.Roslyn4.4.Tests Access Violation crash under NativeAOT #128286
  • Unexpected disk preallocation when extracting GNU sparse tar entries #128283
  • Incorrect stack trace line number when exception originates inside a `foreach` loop body over an iterator method in Release configuration #128282
  • [API Proposal]: Process.RunAndCaptureLinesAsync for reading output lines streaming #128280
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: cDAC dump generation failures in runtime-diagnostics pipeline #128277

Closed

  • [browser] Library with RuntimeIdentifier=browser-wasm shouldn't be SelfContained #123477
    11.0.0

  • [ci-scan] Helix result upload failure: ModuleNotFoundError '_cffi_backend' on macOS/iOS agents #128254
